messages:
sarah: Quick sync on tool-calling launch criteria — want alignment before backlog groom later today.

devon: TLDR on customer asks?

sarah: Main asks: (1) strict JSON schemas for tool outputs; (2) streaming tool responses; (3) retry/fallback semantics; (4) telemetry for model->tool decisions. Prioritization needed.

mikael: From evals, strict schemas catch many regressions. But rigid schemas break 3rd-party actions that return minor fields. Suggest 'required' minimal keys + allow extra fields.

lee: Ops concern: if we allow arbitrary extra fields, need size guardrails. Want per-tool max payload and sampling for logs.

devon: Proposal: schema versioning + compatibility rules: minor changes additive ok; breaking changes need rollout flag + model version pin.

janice: For SDKs, exposing schema validation helper would reduce dev friction. Also recommend server-side validation with clear error codes.

sarah: Launch criteria idea: Beta launch if: schema validator + docs + telemetry + 2 pilot customers; GA requires SDK + streaming + canary rollout plan.

mikael: Example schema snippet:
```json
{
  "type":"object",
  "properties": {
    "order_id":{"type":"string"},
    "status":{"type":"string"}
  },
  "required":["order_id","status"],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

devon: On wire format: call request: tool_call object in assistant message metadata. call result: assistant message with "tool_result" object + optional "tool_trace" for provenance. Example:
```json
{
  "assistant_message": "CALL tool_shipments",
  "tool_result": {"order_id":"123","status":"shipped"},
  "tool_trace":"req_id=abcd"
}
```

lee: Need to define SLOs for tool latency and fallback policy. If tool times out, model should receive a structured failure code: {"error":"timeout","retryable":false}

sarah: Prioritization matrix: customer impact vs engineering effort. Streaming + SDK helpers = high impact, medium effort. Strict enforced schemas = high effort if we enforce transforms.

janice: QA: add fuzz tests for schema looseness and edge cases; gating criteria for rollout.

mikael: Versioning detail: schema has "schema_version" and we support header "Accept-Tool-Schema: v2". Also provide migration docs.

sarah: Action items: Devon draft compatibility rules doc, Janice add test cases, Lee propose ops quotas, Mikael prepare example schema library, I'll coordinate pilot asks. Can we get rough ETA for beta items?

devon: I'll have a draft PR by EOD tomorrow. Janice & Lee can you add tickets?

janice: Added to QA board -> ticket #4587

lee: Created ops RFC -> rfc/ops-tool-quotas, I'll link in the thread.

deploy-bot: deploy status: none.

sarah: Excellent. We'll review in product sync 3pm. :thumbsup:
